Appraiser remarks
The rear quarter panel and left rear bumper cover show fresh crumpling and paint transfer that line up well with the
impact described by the driver during a left-hand turn. Some older scratches sit higher on the same door, and these
may predate this loss, so they are noted separately and excluded from the repair scope. The proposed plan replaces
the bumper cover, repairs and refinishes the quarter panel, and recalibrates the rear sensor. The labor hours
requested fit the extent of the damage, and the invoices submitted reflect a single set of charges with no repeated line
items. Recommend approval of the repair as written.
